# FRA core runtime provenance

Copied runtime files are pinned to repository `ToolsEnabled/fra-security-20261026` at commit `59ada51cfab0a2aaa066d277b5ed0bd81ba122b4`. `PROVENANCE.json` lists each copied runtime byte hash. This package includes the current `src/lib` runtime modules and license only; it does not include tests, reports, deployments, account data, credentials, or desktop application sources.
